purpose: Forced nominal magnetic-beam response boundaries; does not infer chaos from a failed KAM condition.
nominal_physics: Same 32-element frozen modal beam, full magnetic sine/cosine, mass damping, one prescribed uniform transverse field; zero magnetic gradient; no learned-energy surrogate.
field: By=A*(1-exp(-(t/0.25)^2))*sin(r*omega0*t) for independent runs. Continuation changes r at zero-field phase after each run, with no restarted ramp except its first frequency.
integration: Fixed DOP853 order 8, 256 steps/forcing period, simultaneous analytic variational equation, tangent renormalization every period.
lyapunov: Conditional finite-time exponent at fixed forcing phase, mean over last 64 periods; half-window convergence recorded.
spatial_diagnostic: Cubic Hermite Bernstein absolute control-row bound at 128 phases/cycle. Conservative in space at saved phases; not rigorous continuous-time bound.
scope: 4 mm net clearance; operational 20mT field cap. Slopes above .1 rad marked outside a conservative small-slope screening subdomain; .1 is a modeling-screen convention, not an established physical validity threshold.
planned_refinement: Halved time step and doubled burn/measurement duration, higher 4/8 modes and selected full-64-mode implicit solver checks near resonance and 4mm crossings. Direct amplitude bisection for sampled steady/transient 4mm crossings, not an analytic safe threshold.
planned_classification: Report stroboscopic recurrence and conditional FTLE together. Negative finite-time exponent does not prove absence of chaos. Positive exponent requires persistent refinement and valid-slope checks before being called a chaos candidate.
